name: Codependency
overview: Scripture teaches that true security and freedom from fear come from trusting wholly in the LORD rather than relying on human approval or understanding. Psalms 118:6 and Proverbs 29:25 warn against fearing man, showing that such fear ensnares, while trusting God brings safety. Proverbs 3:5 exhorts believers to lean not on their own understanding but to place full confidence in the LORD. Additionally, John 14:26 reminds us that the Holy Spirit guides and teaches us, helping us remember Christ’s words, empowering us to live as servants of God rather than men, as emphasized in Galatians 1:10. This reliance on God alone counters the unhealthy patterns of codependency by redirecting our trust from people to God.
